bio.text: Chris Backemeyer is the Democratic nominee for Nebraska's 1st Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, having advanced from the May 12 primary.

He grew up in Lincoln and has bachelor's degrees in finance and political science from Arizona State University and a master's degree in international affairs from the University of California San Diego.

After a short career in finance, he spent 20 years working for the U.S. Department of State and the National Security Council and served as a national security advisor to former Vice President Kamala Harris.

sources.title: Second Democrat enters 1st Congressional District race
